I answered Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Where that comes from:** Dana Okafor posted in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift. Dana owns the account and said she would look into it.
- **Extra context:** Thea was also the customer contact in #inc-qfl-sev1, the incident where inbound trailers at the Superior terminal were duplicating. Ilse is a member of that channel.

I only used channels Ilse belongs to. I couldn't find an email address or phone number for Thea, so I didn't give one.
